Easier self-hosting.

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- Readable environment variable names, with a ready-made `docker-compose.hub.yml`.
- Sign-in works over plain http when you set `PAPYRA_ALLOW_INSECURE_COOKIES=true` (LAN only — use https otherwise).

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.1...v0.1.2](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)
